observed_owners.finding: JSON latest-state owner; per-task start/prepare/collect lock, unlocked stop and supervisor observation; Popen precedes durable running state; preparation enumerates attempt directories.
Worker observation walks all run/task status files. Shutdown budget is 0.5 seconds, default limits 512 entries, 128 files, 4 MiB. Any issue makes counts null.
Separate unbounded status-file glob; guarded server shutdown uses fresh metrics and refuses nonzero or null running count. In-process request/scheduler lock does not fence independent CLI starts.
In-memory process handles and PID-only OS probes; no process birth identity. Record writer sets heartbeat observation time from file existence.
Existing generic-shell lifecycle wrapper; periodic heartbeat, atomic exit marker; current marker has no attempt or launch token.
Existing Codex wrapper; exit publication and optional accounting receipts are distinct contracts.
Direct latest status.json read must follow the selected authoritative storage owner after cutover.
Existing bounded capture and semantic-refusal evidence must remain separate from process liveness.
MCP delegates worker operations to existing native worker-run commands; preserve this facade.

proposed_model.authority: Project main SQL database owns worker attempt state; workplace stores summaries and references. Search database is excluded.

tables.name: worker_attempts
tables.purpose: Stable project/run/task/attempt identity, execution lifecycle and terminal facts; separate collection outcome; retained history.

tables.name: worker_heads
tables.purpose: Indexed latest-attempt lookup and next-attempt allocation; never enumerate old attempt directories on ordinary prepare.

tables.name: worker_active
tables.purpose: Only reserved/starting/running/stopping/unresolved process ownership; delete only after proven absence, independently of result collection.

proposed_model.collection: Existing prepared input, receipt, completion and semantic-refusal proofs retain authority; completed but uncollected attempts do not imply running processes.
indexes: primary key on worker_active attempt identity
proposed_model.history_pagination: Bounded keyset pages, deterministic terminal sequence, optional snapshot high-water mark; no OFFSET or COUNT history in guard.

required_apis_from_others.contract: Freeze task versus worker ownership, legacy status projection including collect failure, process-absence evidence and project scoping.

Own PF SQL connection/transaction interface, shared project/workplace database resolution, schema version registration, parameter binding, bounded timeouts, typed storage errors and read-only noncreation.
Explicit import/cutover generation, active-coverage proof, resumable idempotent checkpoints, preserved bytes/quarantine, projection publication/recovery and safe rollback fence.

transaction_rules: Commit starting reservation before Popen; no DB transaction spans OS execution, process wait, output reads or history import.
Use per-task lifecycle serialization for all start/status/stop/reconciliation writers and revision plus launch-token compare-and-set for late observations.
An owner crash between reservation and PID attachment leaves unresolved active state; no expiry alone may reclaim it.
Terminal execution update and removal from active set commit together only after proof of process absence; collection is an independent transition.
SQL is sole owner after cutover; status.json is a legacy-shaped derived projection published with recoverable dirty revision. Projection failure never removes active ownership.
Guard uses authoritative active rows and coverage generation, never unverified workplace summaries or historical file scans.

start_stop_fence.requirement: Every independent CLI/MCP/Inspector start and guarded Runtime shutdown shares admission serialization, including project registration changes.
start_stop_fence.proposal: Short workplace admission critical section plus instance-bound stopping fence; standalone projects use project-local admission. Gate precedes task lock and short storage transaction.
start_stop_fence.linearization: A start commits its active reservation before releasing admission; shutdown retains admission through complete active observation and stopping-fence publication. A competing start either precedes the observation or is refused/retried with existing failure semantics.
start_stop_fence.recovery: Fence clearing requires verified owner completion/death; a timeout is not proof. No forever-disabled standalone CLI after Runtime stop.
start_stop_fence.unavailable_workplace: Do not silently bypass an enrolled workplace gate. Pure file/artifact operations remain service-independent.

suggested_file_ownership.condition: Suggestion for next scoped Work only; one writer owns whole tools/processforge.py. W2/W4 supply integration contracts, not concurrent edits.
Shared SQL layer/schema registry paths must be frozen by W2; W3 must not invent or duplicate its connection factory.
Migration-only paths are proposed; updates to shared updater/composition/CLI require separately serialized ownership.
Only if required after design reconciliation; serialized integration by designated native worker, never simultaneous writers.

limitations: No product edits, test/benchmark execution, live process operations, migration, infrastructure changes, commits or pushes.
Serena was available and used; exact shell reads filled an empty symbol search for the monolithic CLI.
Broad test search encountered inaccessible temporary fixtures and nonexistent guessed directories; evidence is restricted to named source smoke files subsequently inspected.
